# Check if the filename is safe and does not allow directory traversal
def is_safe_filename(filename: str) -> bool:
    return not any(part in filename for part in ['..', '/', '\\'])

# Test the function
assert is_safe_filename("peters_mixtape.mp3") == True
assert is_safe_filename("../etc/passwd") == False
assert is_safe_filename("song/track.mp3") == False
